# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

<!-- cap-evolve:framework-improvements-append-below -->

## cand_0001
- The instructions say "EMPTY SEED — create from scratch (no pre-existing content)", but policy/policy.md and tools/tools.py were already fully populated seed artifacts. The EMPTY-SEED block appears to be templated and contradicted the actual on-disk state; it cost time to reconcile. Suggest the harness detect a non-empty capability dir and suppress the empty-seed language.
- The per-task feedback surfaces action-trace detail but stamps it "DIAGNOSTIC ONLY ... do NOT affect reward". For airline this is genuinely the clue to the wrong write, but it's easy to over-index on it. It would help to also surface the COMMUNICATE `communicate_info` targets (e.g. "required to state: 5244") in the summary, since a task can be DB-perfect yet fail purely on communication (task 11) — that root cause is invisible without opening the trace metadata.
- A tiny per-task harness to run the candidate tools against the live domain DB (which I had to hand-roll from the venv) would make VERIFY-THE-FIX much faster and less error-prone.
